content:
ivy: Quick note from QA: compact table rows in the alerts modal clip the kebab actions on some widescreen devices when the modal is narrow. Screenshot: https://img.redwood/shots/2001 :mag:

omar: saw that too. It looks like the menu trigger is absolutely positioned inside the cell and the modal body has overflow:hidden so it gets cropped.

kevin: two options: 1) portal the menu so it sits outside the clipping context, 2) adjust spacing tokens on the action column to give more room. Portaling is more robust but needs focus handling.

ivy: QA priority is to make actions clickable right away. Small token bump sounds fastest. Can we try spacing-token: spacing-1 -> spacing-2 on action cell?

omar: spacing bump works for moderate widths but fails on ultra-narrow modals. Also toasts appearing at top push layout and can temporarily hide the action. Toasts should not reflow modal content.

kevin: agreed. We should portal toasts too. Toasts and menus both need to be out of the modal stacking context. Also ensure tokens for z-index: z-toast < z-menu < z-modal-overlay.

aria-bot: Accessibility reminder: when portaling interactive elements, ensure focus is managed: move focus to popup on open, trap inside popup while open, restore focus to trigger on close. Provide aria-expanded and aria-controls on trigger.

ivy: sounds good. Immediate plan: I'll open a PR for spacing token bump as a quick fix and attach screenshots and QA checklist. Longer-term we'll do portaling + focus management.

kevin: I'll prototype a portaled menu component that exposes onOpen/onClose hooks and returns a focusable wrapper for a11y. Will include keyboard nav (Up/Down/Esc).

omar: I'll change toast positioning to fixed in a portal container and add non-reflow rules. Also will add token names: --toast-z, --menu-z, --modal-z.

qa-bot: QA checklist: confirm action buttons clickable at 320px width, verify keyboard tab order from row -> action -> modal footer, test with NVDA and VoiceOver that focus is restored, ensure toasts do not push content during animation.

ivy: filing issue and assigning owners: spacing PR -> ivy, menu prototype -> kevin, toasts -> omar, a11y checklist -> kevin+ivy. I'll paste links once created. Thanks team :thumbsup:
